# Home Stratosphere

> Home Stratosphere offers personality-based and philosophy-driven home design systems, AI-powered design assessment tools, and practical home finance calculators.

Home Stratosphere combines interior design education with personality frameworks (MBTI, astrology) and design philosophies (Japandi, minimalism, quiet luxury) to help homeowners create spaces aligned with their values. The platform features interactive design courses, AI assessment tools, and financial planning calculators for homeowners.

## Key Topics

- Personality-based design
- MBTI/Myers-Briggs home design
- Astrology-based design
- Japandi design
- Minimalism design
- Quiet luxury design
- Interior design systems
- Design philosophy
- AI design assessment
- Home improvement
- Mortgage calculators
- Scandinavian design
- Japanese design principles
- Wabi-sabi aesthetics
- Hygge design

## Personality-Based Design Systems

- [Personality Type Home Design System](https://www.homestratosphere.com/personality-type-home-design-guide): MBTI-based home design system course with interior design framework
- [Astrology-Based Home Design System](https://www.homestratosphere.com/astrology-home-design): Natal chart-based astrology home design system course with color palettes

## Design Philosophy Courses

- [The Japandi Home Design System](https://www.homestratosphere.com/the-japandi-home-design-system): Japandi design course blending Japanese and Scandinavian design principles
- [The Minimalism Home Design System](https://www.homestratosphere.com/the-minimalism-home-design-system): Minimalism home design system course with interior design principles
- [The Quiet Luxury Home Design System](https://www.homestratosphere.com/the-quiet-luxury-home-design-system): Quiet luxury home design system course with aesthetic principles and guides

## AI Design Assessment Tools

- [Tool: Rate My Room](https://www.homestratosphere.com/rate-my-space): AI-powered room rating tool for interior design analysis and feedback
- [Tool: Rate My Curb Appeal](https://www.homestratosphere.com/rate-my-curb-appeal): AI exterior assessment tool for curb appeal rating and home improvement
- [Tool: Rate My Backyard](https://www.homestratosphere.com/rate-my-backyard): AI landscape design tool for backyard assessment and garden evaluation
- [Free Online Paint Visualizer Software](https://www.homestratosphere.com/paint-visualizer): Free paint visualization tool for interior and exterior color preview

## Home Finance Calculators

- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.homestratosphere.com/mortgage-calculator): Mortgage payment calculator with affordability and refinance options
- [Mortgage Payment Chart](https://www.homestratosphere.com/mortgage-payment-chart): Mortgage payment comparison chart showing rate impact on monthly payments
